params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $r='C:\Users\Xxkan\mhw-mods-work-canonical'; if (!(Test-Path $r)) { Write-Output 'REPO_MISSING'; exit 2 }; git -C $r fetch origin --prune; 'ROOT='+(git -C $r rev-parse --show-toplevel); 'BRANCH='+(git -C $r branch --show-current); 'HEAD='+(git -C $r rev-parse HEAD); 'LOCAL_MAIN='+(git -C $r rev-parse main); 'ORIGIN_MAIN='+(git -C $r rev-parse origin/main); 'DIVERGENCE='+(git -C $r rev-list --left-right --count main...origin/main); 'STATUS_BEGIN'; git -C $r status --porcelain=v1 -b; 'STATUS_END'; 'STASH_BEGIN'; git -C $r stash list; 'STASH_END'; 'WORKTREES_BEGIN'; git -C $r worktree list --porcelain; 'WORKTREES_END'; 'REMOTE_BEGIN'; git -C $r remote -v; 'REMOTE_END'
